title: A picture removed through its location stays in the saved file
symptom: Rust remove_content_at and Python pop_content take out the paragraph that holds the picture but keep the picture's image relationship and media part, so the saved file still carries the picture
workaround: for a body picture in a paragraph of its own, remove that paragraph by index (Rust and Python remove_content), which drops media nothing shows any more; none for a picture in a header, a footer or a table cell
